findings.subject: Narrow safe-retirement proof
findings.finding: Only a fully replayed emergency_recovery_deadline can produce a complete unsuccessful episode. The verifier replays the unchanged supervisor from the original invocation across every consumed interval, requires positive complete admitted six-tick steps, original contiguous observations, matching proposal/dispatch history and leases, and rejects an earlier task terminal or cutoff. Original deadline and quiet-exit precedence are preserved.

findings.subject: Native cancellation and refusal propagation
findings.finding: Retirement requires the original pre/post native cancellation observations, the same actor incarnation and physical state, revoked targets and cleared action/edges/lease, and the correct control-generation fence. Native refusal, uncertain or zero progress, unknown retirement reasons, cancellation failure, proof failure, or durable-evidence failure remain errors. A failed proof cannot authorize another scheduled invocation.

findings.subject: Original task facts and unsuccessful-episode metrics
findings.finding: Safe retirement is an explicitly versioned outcome over the retained native decisions. It does not invent a terminal physical transition or a task deadline. Independent replay reconstructs original rewards and measured character/latency information, requires success false, and assigns the original four-second capped completion cost. Ordinary arrival and the native tick-240 deadline retain their original terminal behavior, including deadline precedence over coincident emergency expiry.

findings.subject: Retained labels, masks, recurrent state and GAE
findings.finding: Unsuccessful teacher episodes retain supported ordinary labels and abstentions without success filtering. Value-less overrides retain None as model-value evidence, train neither actor nor critic, and cut the original GAE trace. Reward and per-tick discounting remain unchanged; safe retirement adds no terminal penalty and does not carry reward across an emergency gap. Recurrent reset and fixed-window behavior remain unchanged. Consequently, retaining a safe failure is not itself proof of a new negative learning signal or an effective parameter update.

findings.subject: Quiet exit exactly at an administrative cutoff
findings.finding: The original failure was reproduced when quiet recovery completed at the cutoff peek after a consumed override: capture correctly retained a nonzero real value, but legacy rollout validation rejected it because the final learning row was masked. The V3 converter now first rejects nonfinite original values, then uses a zero internal bootstrap placeholder only for a complete admitted trace-complete six-tick override at an administrative cutoff with a real valid final observation. The persisted actual value, observation hash and forward charges remain intact and replay independently. Since unchanged GAE skips the last masked row and cuts the trace, this projection cannot change a trainable return. Ordinary cutoffs, safe-retirement zero bootstrap, and legacy rejection remain unchanged.

findings.subject: Deterministic PPO continuation and bounded progress
findings.finding: The fixed seeded case stream advances once per actual episode and continues across updates independently of outcomes. Safe failures consume their scheduled entries, cannot be replaced, and remain in the exact 256-confirmed-decision update count. Positive-progress requirements and the frozen per-update/total start ceilings bound fragmentation. Complete counters describe receipt-complete captures, including administrative PPO truncations, rather than success.

findings.subject: Qualification and comparison denominators
findings.finding: The implementation retains all 32 open and 224 sealed case/controller rows, all three seeds, and the six-final freeze before sealed evaluation. Safe failures are unsuccessful rows in the original denominators. The original whole-family success, own-initial/authored improvement, character, latency and integrity gates and whole-BC-family preference remain unchanged. No partial or complete negative result can establish learned-actuation success, owner feel, morphology release, or closure of issue #62.

findings.subject: Version separation and historical evidence
findings.finding: New episode, terminal, retirement, execution, capture and audit behavior is explicitly versioned. Legacy V1/V2 dispatch and rollout validation retain their prior meaning. The consumed LEARN-JOLT-002 allocation is not reopened or reinterpreted, and no historical result or prior qualification is upgraded by this review.

findings.subject: Physical admission remains refused
findings.finding: The resource report remains explicit incomplete planning evidence. Measured components already exceed their declared shared-clock phases, and native host work, full semantic audit, neural work, complete publication overhead, process cleanup and aggregate worker/native memory remain unresolved. A passing offline semantic review supplies no experiment declaration or feasibility admission and spends no allocation.

remaining_physical_admission_requirement: A defensible complete source/runtime/host-bound time and memory envelope covering active work, closure, independent audit, publication, external verification, stream/receipt finalization, and observed exit under the original single shared-clock limits.
Any change to the commissioned total, phase allocations, counters, cases, objective, or learning design requires the applicable owner-authorized amendment; this review makes no such change.
A fresh valid exact-source execution declaration with required independent prospective reviews and all frozen prerequisite, host, runtime, configuration and case-stream bindings.
The allocation must remain unopened and unspent until all admission gates pass; no fit, physical evaluation, replacement attempt, resume or deadline extension is authorized by this offline review.
limitations: The acceptance field applies only to the reviewed offline software semantics. This JSON is not a passing prospective experiment-admission review.
Synthetic receipt owners and freshly initialized CPU networks are not measured Cybersand behavior, trained-policy performance, owner-feel evidence or usable qualification.
The full offline suite includes explicitly skipped actual-host and CUDA integration checks; those capabilities remain unmeasured.
The reviewer authored the two disclosed regression-test files; separate review is required to characterize those tests as independently authored.
Synthetic component timing uses bounded specimens and a declared planning factor with cache effects and unresolved work; it is not a whole-pipeline worst-case guarantee.
No complete experiment output, learned family, valid physical negative, held-out evaluation, or owner acceptance was produced.
Required checks on the final PR head and merge verification remain coordinator gates; this semantic review does not waive them or claim that pending hosted checks have passed.
verdict: No blocking finding remains in the reviewed offline terminal, cancellation, learning, replay, deterministic scheduling, qualification-denominator and legacy-compatibility semantics. The quiet-exit cutoff defect is fixed while preserving actual retained values and unchanged loss/GAE semantics. Accept the software only within this offline scope. Physical experiment admission remains refused, the allocation remains unspent, and the learned-actuation objective remains open.
